messages:
nina (PM): FYI I'm consolidating the Dedicated roadmap items we promised customers into a single launch checklist. want to align scope for reserve pools + burst + autoscale rules.

jess (Eng): thanks — main questions: do we ship with soft-preempt only, or include hard preempt as opt-in? soft-only simplifies infra but makes SLOs fuzzy.

carlos (SRE): soft-preempt is lower ops load at launch. hard preempt needs eviction-runbooks + downstream retries. also need an incident playbook for spillover.

rachel (Sales): customers in the beta asked for a guaranteed burst window (3–5m) for critical flows. they said soft-preempt alone won't cut it.

nina (PM): noted. proposal: MVP = reserved pools (committed capacity), soft spillover, and explicit burst credits per tenant. Hard preempt as "v1.1" gated by customer legal + billing changes. thoughts?

jess (Eng): MVP sounds feasible. technical ask: we need a quota enforcement shim that is fast-path in the runtime (O(1) decision). if we push enforcement to control-plane it'll add latency.

carlos (SRE): agree on runtime enforcement. also we should expose per-pool eviction metrics to console, otherwise oncall will be blind.

opsbot: Deploy scheduled: feature/quotas-runtime-shim -> staging at 2026-04-09T02:00Z (CI: green) :white_check_mark:

tom (Data): For launch criteria we need three metrics: 99th token latency delta <= 15% vs baseline, burst hit-rate >= 95% for credited requests, and spillover error rate < 0.5% for production traffic.

nina (PM): adding those to launch gates. also adding: billing mapping in place (who gets charged when spillover occurs) + legal ok on SLA wording.

rachel (Sales): legal is asking for sample SLA text. can we provide a conservative promise: "Burst windows are best-effort and may be preempted during cluster emergencies; reserved capacity is guaranteed during customer window."

jess (Eng): that wording seems fair. Implementation detail: burst credits are consumed from per-tenant token buckets; buckets refill per-window. we should document the refill cadence.

nina (PM): doc action: produce "Bill of Materials" (BoM) listing infra changes, console UX, billing contract changes, and oncall runbooks. I'll draft. owners?

jess (Eng): infra changes: runtime quota shim, KV cache isolation per-pool, and an admission controller for reserved pools. owner: @jess by 2026-04-01.

carlos (SRE): oncall: eviction runbook + monitoring dashboards + pager thresholds. owner: @carlos by 2026-04-05.

tom (Data): telemetry: add per-pool token consumption, burst credit balance, and spillover counts to the export. owner: @tom by 2026-04-03.

rachel (Sales): billing/contract: sample SLA + pricing delta for reserved vs burst. owner: @rachel with finance by 2026-04-06.

nina (PM): good. risk register quick notes: 1) latency regressions from runtime shim; 2) customer confusion on burst semantics; 3) billing disputes on spillover.

jess (Eng): mitigation: ship runtime shim behind opt-in flag and run canary with heavy prefix caching to measure latency. canary window: 48h on staging traffic replay.

carlos (SRE): ops mitigation: add an automated rollback if 99th latency > 20% for > 10m during canary. and create a synthetic saturation test to exercise spillover.

nina (PM): launch checklist (MVP) — summarised: \n  - infra runtime shim (jess)\n  - telemetry + dashboards (tom)\n  - oncall runbook (carlos)\n  - billing & SLA text (rachel)\n  - docs UX: console view of pool + credit balance (jess + product docs)\n  - canary + rollback policy (eng + sres)

rachel (Sales): customer comms draft: "We're opening early access for reserved pools. Initially: soft spillover and burst credits; hard preemption coming in a later release." will post to customers once SLA text and BoM are ready.

nina (PM): next sync Thursday 10am PT. prework: jess posts PR link to runtime prototype, tom posts telemetry schema, carlos posts initial runbook draft.

jess (Eng): PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/2345 — prototype sensor + shim. perf numbers attached.

tom (Data): telemetry schema: `pool_id, tenant_id, token_count, burst_credit_balance, spillover_flag, timestamp` — will push to staging export.

carlos (SRE): runbook draft: includes steps for manual drain, emergency preempt opt-in, and customer-notify play. will link in thread before Thu.

nina (PM): perfect. final ask: everyone's ok with shipping MVP without hard preempt? quick thumbs please.

jess (Eng): :thumbsup:

carlos (SRE): :thumbsup:

rachel (Sales): :thumbsup: (but flagging account HQ who needs hard preempt eventually)

opsbot: Thread archived after 7 days of inactivity.
